name: chan
algorithm: Channel ping-pong: one side sends 0..n-1 on a channel of capacity 1 and waits for each value to come back on a second one; the checksum is the sum of the values received (README.md).

skip.c: no std channel in C (C11 threads.h has mutexes and condition variables, no channel)
skip.zig: no std channel in Zig (std.Thread has Mutex and Condition, no channel)
skip.mk-wrap: the only arithmetic is the sum, which stays below 2^62

no_counts: B24 does not apply: the checksum, the sum of the n values, shows that every value made the round trip
notes: Concurrency row (B19): every column runs on logical CPUs 0 and 2 (mask 0x5, two physical cores) with 2 threads (MK_CARRIERS=2, GOMAXPROCS=2). Rust uses OS threads (its std has no tasks), labelled so.
